verdict.rationale: Trello is a hosted SaaS product, so a published uptime SLA and a public status page are fair questions for it. The evidence pack contains nothing on either: no uptime SLA, no status page, and no incident communication. The docs cover only features, Power-Ups, auth and the API, and the community items are unrelated to uptime.

support.subject: As a product manager, I know the vendor's published uptime SLA and can check real-time incident status via a public status page
